title: Nutty Crispy French Chicken Hash
description: A funky, crispy French dish featuring ground nut oil, perfect for a hangover cure, made with low-calorie-friendly ingredients. This recipe is a twist on traditional French cuisine with a nutty flavor.
instructions: Heat the ground nut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the diced potato to the skillet and cook until it is tender and lightly browned.
Season the mixture with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Use a spatula to press the mixture down into the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir the mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until it is crispy and golden brown.
Serve the Nutty Crispy French Chicken Hash hot.
